faq.q: How is a titanium rocket motor case manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium rocket motor case is manufactured using Closed-die forging; 5-axis CNC machining; Heat treatment (STA); Shot peening. Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium rocket motor case?

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium rocket motor case?
faq.a: With proper material selection (Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V) and manufacturing process control (thread rolling, heat treatment), titanium titanium rocket motor case components exhibit excellent fatigue life and corrosion resistance in service.
